name: Hyper Euphoria
original_name: ハイパー・ユーフォリア
source:
A body suddenly explodes in Suiyo Park, H City, Saitama Prefecture, Japan!

Concluding this was a murder involving “psychokinesis,” the local police commissioned two girls, “Psychokinetic Detectives” (detectives possessing “psychokinesis”), to investigate.

The investigation moves from Saitama Prefecture to Yamaguchi Prefecture, then to Hiroshima Prefecture. What will the girls ultimately witness...?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4012840/]Steam[/url]]
